*Saññojanadukādi* ("Fetters Dyad, etc.") is a canonical Abhidhamma text cataloged as Patthana 14.19 within the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Like other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, it applies the systematic matrix of twenty-four conditional relations (*paccaya*) to analytical classifications, specifically concerning the category of the fetters (*saññojana*) and related dyadic groupings (*duka*) [SuttaCentral].
